title: Find places reopens on the last results even when the page's storage refuses the whole answer: a lighter form (no checks, stats or scores, asked again after restore) is kept, and a refused write is reported instead of silently leaving only the place, which made every visit run a new paid search
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed) run the client test file named in run.cmd.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A store that refuses the whole answer gets the lighter form, which still restores all places with their photos; a store that refuses even that reports `none` and remembers no search.

tests: the last search is kept whole when it fits; a store that refuses it gets the lighter form, which still restores
a store that refuses even the lighter form reports it and remembers no search
openingStep: last results first, then the remembered place, then locate; never over a search already on screen
